scores.rationale: Thorough and operationally useful, but far too long and forces a 757-day heterogeneous dataset into one campaign narrative despite repeatedly acknowledging broken chronology, ambiguous tooling, inferred roles, and unknown movement direction.

Correctly treats the broad scope as competing ranked scenarios, calibrates uncertainty, identifies precise zoom windows, and preserves alternative authorised-activity explanations, though some aggregate infrastructure claims lack event-level citation and containment guidance is limited.

why: It matches the broad-case analytical altitude and gives responders concise, confidence-ranked hypotheses and targeted next pivots without inventing a single continuous intrusion story.
